book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Inchchirachcha Hargey Oykkida Addeza Paththides
Yesusi zuma bollafe wodhdhiin daro derey iza kaallides.
Issi inchchirachcha
hargey dizaadey Yesusaakko shiiqidi iza sinththan gulbatidi, «Godoo! Ne koykko tana paththanaas dandayaasa» gides.
Yesusi ba kushe yeddidi, «Ta dosadis; paxa!» giin addezi he hargezappe heerakka paxides.
Qasseka Yesusi addeza, «Ne paxidayssa oonaska yootoppa; gido attiin baada nena qeeses bessa. Istti azazida yarshoza gaththa; hessika isttas markka gidana» gides.
Yesusi Mato Halaqaza Ashkara Paththides
Yesusi Qifirnahoome gakkida mala mato halaqay izakko shiiqidi iza hizgi woossides.
«Godoo! Ta ashkaray keehi sakettidi keeththan ichchi dees» gides.
Yesusikka izas, «Ta baada paththana» gides.
Mato halaqazi izas zaaridi, «Ta nena ta keeththe gelththanaas bessizaade gidikke; gido attiin ne haan daada issi qaala xalla giikko ta ashkaray paxana.

Taaska tana azaziza halaqati taappe bollara deettes; qasseka taas azazettiza wottadarati taappe garsara deettes; isttafe issaa, ‹Ba!› giikko bees; qasse issaa, ‹Haa ya!› giikko yees; tani ta ashkaraza, ‹Hessa ooththa!› giikko ooththees» gides.
Yesusi iza zaarozan malalettidi bana kaallizaytas, «Ta inttes tumu gays; haray attoshin Isra7eele asaa garsan hayssa mala ammanoy dizaade issaadeka demmabeekke.
Ta inttes yootays; daroti arshey mokkiza baggafenne wulliza baggafe yaana. Salo Kawoteththa maaddan Abrahaamenttara Yisaaqanttaranne Yaaqoobenttara issife uttana.
Salo Kawoteththi isttas gidana bessiza asati heen kare dhuman yegettana. Heenkka yeehonne achcha garccech gidana» gides.
Yesusikka mato halaqazas, «Ba! Ne ammano mala nees hano» gides; ashkarazi heerakka paxides.
Yesusi Darota Paththides
Yesusikka buro Phexroosa keeththe gelishin Phexroosa bolloteya misho harge sakettada ichchidaaro be7ides.
Izi kushe Yesusi bochchiin misho hargezi aggides. Izakka dendada Yesusa mokkadus.
He gallassa omars daydanththi oykkida daro asata Yesusaakko ehida. Izikka tuna ayanata ba qaalara isttafe kessides; harganchchata ubbaaka paththides.
Isayaasi, «Izi nu harge ekkides; nu sakokka tookkides» gida qaalay hayssan polettides.
Daro asay iza giddoththidayssa biyidi Yesusi asaa abbafe he pinth pinnana mala azazides.
He wode issi Ayhuda ammano tamaarsizaadey izakko shiiqidi, «Astamaaree! Ne bizaso awakka ta nena kaallana» gides.
Yesusikka izas zaaridi, «Worakanatas ollay dees; salo kafotas keeththi dees; taas Asa Naas gidikko hu7e gelththizasoykka deenna» gides.
Iza kaalliza issi hara asi qasse, «Godoo! Koyro baada ta aawa moogoo?»
gides.
Izi qasse, «Hayqqidayti ba hayqeth moogetto; neni gidikko tana kaalla» gides.
Yesusi Abba Dambala Co7u Histtides
Hessafe guye Yesusikka wogolon geliin iza kaallizaytikka izara issife bida.
Qoppontta abba giddon dambalay dendidi wogoloyo mittana gakkanaas istta waayisides. Hessi wuri hanishin Yesusi dhiskides.
Iza kaallizayti iza beegoththidi, «Godoo! Nu dhayoos; nuna ashsha!» gida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Intteno ammanoy paccidaytoo! Aazas hayssa mala babbetii?» gides. Hessafe dendidi carkozanne abba dambalaa izi hanqiin heerakka sirphi gides.
Isttika, «Hayssi abbaynne carkoyka izas azazettizaadey izi waanidaadee?» giidi malalettida.
Tuna Ayanappe Paxida Nam7u Asata

Izi abba pinnidi Gergesenoone geetettiza dere gakkida mala daydanththi oykkida nam7u as dayti ba diza duufoppe kezidi izara gaaggida. Asi he ogezara aadhdhanaas dandayetontta mala asas daro keehi meto gidi deettes.
Isttika, «Xoossa Nawu! Nees nunara aaza issifeteththi dizee? Wodey gakkontta dishin nuna xuuggana yadii?» gi waassida.
Heen isttafe guuth haakkidi daro guddunththa wudey issi bolla heemettees.
Daydanththati Yesusa, «Ne nuna kessanaa gidikko haytan daro guddunththatan nu gelana mala nuus piqaade imma» giidi woossida.
Yesusikka istta, «Biite!» gides. Daydanththatikka isttafe kezidi guddunththatan gelida. Guddunththati wurikka ba dizaso aafora bichcharishe abban gelidi haaththan mitetti hayqqida.
Guddunththaa heemmizayti elelidi katamay dizaso biidi guddunthay hanoyssanne daydanththi istta oykkida asata bolla hanidayssa ubbaa asaas yootida.
Katamaa asay wuri Yesusara gaagganaas kezides. Yesusa be7idinne istta dere yeddi baana mala iza woossida.

footnotes.text: Inchchirachcha: Inchchirachcha Geeshsha Maxaafay qonccisiza mala asateththa bolla bollara galban keziza dumma dumma hargeta ubbaa bessees.
Ta aawa moogoo? gizayssi iza aaway hayqqana gakkanawu heemmidi hayqqiko moogi yaanaas diza iza amoza bessiza misatees.
